structural-causal.name: alignment2036
structural-causal.basis: Phosphate and potash replenish crop nutrients that support agricultural output.

structural-causal.name: bottleneckControl
structural-causal.basis: Mosaic controls meaningful nutrient production assets, but sulfur/input economics can become the binding constraint.

structural-causal.name: scenarioRobustness
structural-causal.basis: Food production need is durable while fertilizer affordability, crop economics and input costs remain cyclical.

structural-causal.name: substitutionResilience
structural-causal.basis: Farmers can optimize rates and nutrient sources, but phosphorus and potassium requirements cannot be eliminated indefinitely without yield/soil tradeoffs.

discovery-weak-signals.name: crop-nutrient essentiality versus input-cost pressure
discovery-weak-signals.basis: The business supplies essential potash/phosphate inputs, but sulfur-cost inflation was severe enough to curtail SSP production in Brazil.

adversarial-red-team.name: inputCostExposure
adversarial-red-team.basis: Sulfur inflation was severe enough to extend production curtailments.

adversarial-red-team.name: commodityCyclicality
adversarial-red-team.basis: Nutrient need persists, but realized margins depend on fertilizer prices, crop economics, supply response and feedstock costs.

adversarial-red-team.name: confidenceInflation
adversarial-red-team.basis: Product essentiality and a dividend should not be extrapolated into durable margin resilience.

expectations-execution.name: operational discipline
expectations-execution.basis: Curtailment can protect economics but also signals real cost pressure and lost production opportunity.
